title: Publish authoring session restore metadata
summary: Extend the HumbleStudio localhost manifests with explicit authoring session restore metadata so HumbleControl can treat browser-local workspace snapshots as a supported no-write capability.
acceptance_criteria: Connection and prepare-edit manifests advertise an authoring-session restore capability.
Every supported app export includes an authoringSession descriptor with Control workspace URL, browser-local storage posture, restored state fields, and writes:false.
Fallback guards and local preview tests assert the authoring session contract.
Documentation keeps the restore flow separate from any future apply/write path.
Verification and promotion evidence are recorded before closing the ticket.

evidence.note: Studio connection and prepare-edit manifests now advertise authoring-session-restore and include per-export authoringSession descriptors.
control-edit-boundary.md now states that browser-local authoring snapshots restore working state but do not permit repository mutation.
Local preview manifest tests passed: 14 tests.

evidence.path: python3 Scripts/validate_humble_tickets.py && python3 Scripts/validate_repo_contract.py && bash Scripts/run_local_checks.sh --workflow-only && git diff --check
evidence.note: Repo ticket, contract, workflow-only, and whitespace checks passed after implementation.

trigger.source_ref: Jan accepted the next Top 10 item: Authoring session backbone.

agent_notes: Studio is only publishing metadata here; no real edit/apply endpoint is introduced.
Authoring session restore remains browser-local Control state and must not become source truth.
